note: Working tree has uncommitted changes on top of commit 7f90f26, not committed per instructions. (1) scripts/build-docs.mjs's link checker was redesigned: the hand-rolled regex markdown parser is gone, replaced by walking marked's own lexer token stream for source links (so code fences and reference-style links behave exactly as they render); after the build writes all pages, a single artifact-wide pass reads every generated HTML file's href="..." (shell, nav, language switch, and body alike) and asserts each resolves to a file actually written, plus validates in-page #anchor links against the heading ids the build generates; a separate content-language check, independent of the renderer, asserts marker-carrying links resolve to that language and that each paired doc's crossover link resolves to its own counterpart page. Verified against a 9-case mutation table (resolver fallback, fragment-marker-disabled, dir-marker-regex-broken, dead .md link, dead non-.md link, broken nav href, broken language-switch fallback, inverted #en/#de marker, dead in-page anchor) — every mutation fails the build — and against 3 previously-false-positive cases (a deep link into another doc's section, a link inside a code fence, a bare directory link) — all 3 now pass. Net change to build-docs.mjs: +3 lines (123 insertions, 120 deletions), i.e. materially flat despite deleting the old parser and adding the artifact-wide check. (2) A round of accuracy fixes to WEB_DIR's actual resolved path (repo root, not src/server/), calculateWeights' real signature, the digest slice notation (hex chars, not bytes), a wrong section cross-reference (§ 2 -> § 3), the #/team/:id route (no literal /spin segment), the Docker volume path (/data), a stale nonce example, the audit CI job's real (parallel, no needs:) relationship to verify, upcast's real behavior (identity function, not empty), README.de.md's missing canonical marker and translation-lag banner, a German calque ('Auf blankem Metall' -> 'Auf Bare Metal'), and a dropped counterfactual qualifier in a German paragraph about default network reachability. (3) docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-optional-postgres-redis.md marked historical (Postgres/Redis support has shipped; its 21 checkboxes were never updated retroactively).

(g) the enOnly language-switch fallback reverted, re-emitting a href to a page never written (docs/de/security.html) — failed, reproducing the exact defect the check exists to catch. (h) README.de.md's #en marker on its own English-counterpart link inverted to #de — failed via the pairing check, which does not merely trust the href's own marker. (i) a dead in-page anchor added — failed via the heading-id check. All 9/9 failed the build. Then 3 previously-rejected-but-legitimate cases were tried and all passed: a deep link into another doc's section (`deployment.md#environment`), a markdown link inside a fenced code block, and a bare directory link (`../de/`).
